# CmsForNerd v4.1.0

- **Live Demo:** [https://cmsfornerd.onrender.com/index.php](https://cmsfornerd.onrender.com/index.php)
- **MCP standard crawler Access:** [https://context7.com/cmsfornerd/cmsfornerd/llms.txt?tokens=10000](https://context7.com/cmsfornerd/cmsfornerd/llms.txt?tokens=10000)

> CmsForNerd is a hardened, flat-file PHP laboratory CMS targeting PHP 8.4+ strict types, PHPStan Level 8
> static analysis, Zero-Global variables (via Registry), and "Pair Logic" (Logic in `.php` files, UI in
> `-body.inc` files). It supports Dual-View rendering (Standard with hybrid-SPA AJAX routing and AMP via
> `?view=amp`) controlled by `themes/CmsForNerd/pager.php`.

## Architectural Standards

- **PHP 8.4+ & Strict Types:** The codebase enforces strict types (`declare(strict_types=1);`) and modern features.
- **PHPStan Level 8:** Absolute type safety with strict static analysis across the entire application.
- **Zero-Global Architecture:** Prohibits `global` and `$GLOBALS`. All state is stored in `\CmsForNerd\Registry`.
- **Pair Logic Pattern:** Separates business logic (e.g., `graduation.php`) from UI fragments (`graduation-body.inc`).
- **Dual-View & AMP:** Centralized routing in `pager.php` with automated AMP transformation.
